# Lotter Law — Orlando Criminal Defense & DUI Attorney

> The Law Office of Jeff Lotter, PLLC is a criminal defense and DUI firm in Orlando, Florida. Attorney Jeff Lotter is a former Florida Highway Patrol State Trooper (2003–2009) and Orange County Deputy Sheriff (2009–2015), a former U.S. Army Military Police officer, a FAMU College of Law graduate, and a Valencia Public Safety Institute police-academy instructor. The firm uses that law-enforcement background — plus analysis of local Orange County court data — to defend DUI, traffic, drug, weapons, theft, and assault/battery cases across Central Florida.

Use this file to locate authoritative, firm-authored content. The blog explains Florida criminal and traffic law in plain language and documents real case outcomes. Pages marked "Case Result" describe actual dispositions the firm obtained.

- Service area: Orange, Seminole, Osceola, and Brevard counties (Orlando metro)
- Office: 200 E. Robinson St., Suite 1140, Orlando, FL 32801
- Phone / text: 407-500-7000 — En Español: 407-536-7508
- Email: jeff@jlotterlaw.com
- Citation policy: content may be quoted with attribution and a link to https://lotterlaw.com

## Practice Areas

- [DUI Defense](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/dui.html): Orlando DUI defense — challenging breath tests, field sobriety exercises, and unlawful traffic stops.
- [Criminal Traffic](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/criminal-traffic.html): Reckless driving, driving while license suspended (DWLS), and leaving the scene.
- [Speeding Tickets](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/speeding-ticket.html): Fighting speeding citations to protect your license and avoid points.
- [Excessive / Super Speeder](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/excessive-speed.html): Criminal "super speeder" charges (50+ over, 100+ mph) under FSS 316.1922.
- [Suspended License](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/suspended-license.html): DWLSR, no valid driver license (NVDL), and habitual traffic offender (HTO) defense.
- [Driver License Restoration](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/driver-license-restoration.html): DHSMV formal review hearings — the 10-day window to save a license after a DUI.
- [Seal & Expunge](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/seal-and-expunge.html): Sealing or expunging a Florida criminal record and checking eligibility.
- [Drug Offenses](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/drug-offense.html): Possession, sale, and trafficking defense.
- [Weapons Charges](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/weapons.html): Gun charges, concealed-carry issues, and restoring firearm rights.
- [Assault, Battery & Domestic Violence](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/assault-battery.html): Simple assault, aggravated battery, and DV defense.
- [Theft](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/theft.html): Shoplifting, petit theft, and grand theft defense.
- [Hit and Run](https://lotterlaw.com/practice-areas/hit-and-run.html): Leaving the scene of a crash — property damage and injury cases.

## Key Legal Guides

- [DUI vs DWI in Florida: Complete Defense Guide](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/dui-dwi-defense-florida-guide/): Why Florida charges only DUI (not DWI), BAC limits, penalties, and defense strategies.
- [Florida's New DUI Refusal Law (Oct 2025)](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/new-dui-refusal-law/): Refusing a breath test is now a criminal misdemeanor — penalties and rights.
- [Challenging the HGN Eye Test](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/challenging-hgn-eye-test-dui/): How the horizontal gaze nystagmus field sobriety test is challenged in DUI cases.
- [The Intoxilyzer 8000](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/intoxilyzer-8000-florida-history/): History and reliability issues of Florida's breath-test machine.
- [Refusing Roadside Sobriety Tests](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/refuse-sfst/): Your right to decline field sobriety exercises in Florida and why it matters.
- [Motion to Suppress: What to Expect](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/motion-to-suppress-what-to-expect/): How illegally obtained evidence gets excluded at a suppression hearing.
- [Your Rights During a Florida Traffic Stop](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/traffic-stop-rights-florida/): What you can and can't do when pulled over.
- [Florida Privacy Rights Beyond Miranda](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/florida-privacy-rights-beyond-miranda/): The state constitutional privacy protections that go further than Miranda.
- [Florida Stand Your Ground Law](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/florida-stand-your-ground-law/): How Florida's self-defense and Stand Your Ground law works.
- [Clear Your Criminal Record: Sealing & Expungement](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/sealing-expunging-criminal-records/): Step-by-step on sealing or expunging a Florida record.
- [First Court Appearance in Orlando](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/first-court-appearance-orlando/): Bond, your rights, and what happens at the first appearance.

## Case Results

- [DUI Acquittal: Missing Evidence Creates Reasonable Doubt](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/corpus-delicti-authority-vs-evidence-dui-trial/): Jury acquittal where the State could not prove who was driving.
- [Trial-Ready Defense Forces Favorable DUI Resolution (Brevard)](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/trial-ready-dui-metabolites-brevard/): DUI reduced to reckless driving — metabolites vs. active impairment.
- [Firearm Possession Dismissed: Unlawful Terry Frisk](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/felon-possession-firearm-dismissed-terry-frisk/): Firearm charge dismissed over an unlawful stop-and-frisk.
- [Securely Encased vs. Concealed Carry — Charges Dismissed](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/securely-encased-concealed-carry-dismissed/): Florida's "securely encased" firearm defense.
- [A Tale of Two Officers: DUI Dismissal](https://lotterlaw.com/blog/Case-Analysis-01-fellow-officer-rule/): Dismissal under the fellow-officer rule when officers failed to communicate.
